title: Convert a good-event structural work bound into bounded-error expected work
statement: If the capped learner has correct-event work<=P(n,log1/epsilon)*2^g_cond and all-branch work<=P*2^n, use internal failure epsilon=delta*2^-n. Then expected bit/known-code work is polynomial(n,n+log1/delta)*(2^g_cond+delta), with bounded-error correctness and finite exponential worst-case work.

requires: An actual simultaneous correctness/work event and literal finite all-branch caps for the same learner, including failed/malformed scans.
provides: If the capped learner has correct-event work<=P(n,log1/epsilon)*2^g_cond and all-branch work<=P*2^n, use internal failure epsilon=delta*2^-n. Then expected bit/known-code work is polynomial(n,n+log1/delta)*(2^g_cond+delta), with bounded-error correctness and finite exponential worst-case work.
assumptions: Wrong answers remain possible within the stated allowance. No unconditional FPT worst-case guarantee or physical latency theorem follows.
costs: Larger correction/collection/proposal caps, bits and comparisons at log1/epsilon=O(n+log1/delta); separately pay source latency and controls.
contract.units: delta and epsilon are distinct dimensionless failure allowances; work is counted bit/code/logical-query work.
contract.obstruction: A small probability of an exponentially expensive wrong-prefix branch cannot be ignored in an expected-runtime claim.

body: Encode the rational allowance by an n-bit denominator shift. Split expectation over the simultaneous correct/capped event and its complement without conditioning away bad tapes. The latter contributes at mostdelta*2^-n*P*2^n. The conditional-frame scan explicitly returns UNKNOWN on malformed final models so the all-branch bound is genuine. This changes confidence work/caps and is available to the same-information retaining method. It does not create Las Vegas correctness or cap independently unbounded source latency.
